newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk anti-rebel village guard found shot dead.
newsitem.headline: Turk anti-rebel village guard found shot dead.

text.p: A member of an anti-rebel militia was found shot dead on Thursday on wasteland in the Turkish southeastern province of Diyarbakir, security officials said.
They said the victim, Hasan Lalealp, was among nine villagers abducted last weekend by guerrillas of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK). They gave no information on the other eight.
The Turkish government arms and pays around 70,000 villagers to fight PKK rebels in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
Separately, a Turkish soldier died in a land mine blast in the southeastern province of Mardin, security officials told Reuters. He was involved in mine clearance work, they said.
More than 22,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between Turkish security forces and PKK rebels, who are fighting for autonomy or independence in the southeast.
